Python sürümü değişti; sanal ortam yeni: Python version changed; the virtual environment was rebuilt with the new version
Sürüm değişince sanal ortam (.venv) yeni: When the version changes, the virtual environment (.venv) is rebuilt from scratch with the new version and dependencies must be reinstalled. Other versions are installed by the administrator on the Components page.
Uygulamanızın gereksinimlerini site klas: Write your application's requirements to requirements.txt or pyproject.toml in the site folder (requirements.txt is used if both exist). Packages are installed only into this site's virtual environment and do not affect other applications on the server.
